dotnet.notes: Requires the .NET-enabled editor build; no C# web export; Android export needs .NET 9+.

sources.claim: Signals are a first-class type since Godot 4.0; connect takes a Callable
GDScript: declare with the signal keyword; emit with signal.emit(); connect a Callable; bind extra args
Object.connect/disconnect/emit_signal/is_connected and ConnectFlags values (DEFERRED=1, PERSIST=2, ONE_SHOT=4, REFERENCE_COUNTED=8); duplicate connect returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER
Node lifecycle signals: ready, tree_entered, tree_exiting, tree_exited, renamed
C#: [Signal] delegate must end with EventHandler; generates event + SignalName; EmitSignal(SignalName.X); += / -=; rebuild required; cannot use Invoke
C#: no bind/unbind (use lambdas); await ToSignal(obj, Class.SignalName.X)
C# requires the .NET editor build and .NET 8 SDK (9 for Android)
C# cannot export to the Web platform
